draft_metadata.identity_reason: 原文题名 'BIOCONVERSION AND BIOSYNTHESIS OF NANAOMYCINS USING CERULENIN, A SPECIFIC INHIBITOR OF FATTY ACID AND POLYKETIDE BIOSYNTHESES'、作者 CHIAKI KITAO, HARUO TANAKA, SHIZUKO MINAMI and SATOSHI OMURA (Kitasato University and The Kitasato Institute, 5-9-1 Shirokane, Minato-ku, Tokyo 108, Japan)、收稿日期 March 19, 1980、期刊 The Journal of Antibiotics Vol. XXXIII No. 7 (1980 年 7 月) pp. 711–716、DOI 10.7164/antibiotics.33.711 均与 Zotero 元数据完全一致。
draft_metadata.title_zh: 利用浅蓝霉素 (cerulenin) 研究七尾霉素 (nanaomycins) 的生物转化与生物合成——一种脂肪酸与聚酮生物合成的特异性抑制剂
draft_metadata.filename_title: 七尾霉素的生物转化与生物合成研究
draft_metadata.classification_reason: 本论文属于次级代谢产物 (聚酮化合物) 生物合成路径解析领域。原文利用聚酮合成特异性抑制剂 cerulenin 在 *Streptomyces rosa* var. *notoensis* OS-3966 中阻断从头合成、再以外源喂入单一中间体的'生物转化'方式推断 NNM-D → NNM-A → NNM-E → NNM-B 的途径顺序；论文未涉及基因簇克隆、酶工程改造或异源重构等细胞工厂/酶工程操作，因此 category 设为 null。
source_gaps: 原文在'化学转化对照'段落引用了 '(data not shown)'：在不接菌的相同培养基中 37 °C/30 h 条件下，NNM-A → NNM-D 的微弱自发转化与 NNM-B → NNM-A 的快速自发转化仅以文字描述给出，文中未提供独立图版或定量数据。
参考文献 15 (OMURA, S.; S. MINAMI, I. TAKAHASHI, H. TANAKA & C. KITAO: unpublished data) 标注为未发表数据，正文中未呈现具体结果。

verified_claims.claim: OS-3966 在无 cerulenin 条件下发酵产量约 230 µg NNM/ml (以 NNM-E 为标准品)
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.712 Results and Discussion 首段
verified_claims.evidence: 'Strain OS-3966 produced about 230 µg of NNM per ml (determined by bioassay as NNM-E)'

verified_claims.claim: 40 µg/ml cerulenin 完全抑制 NNM 生产而不抑制菌体生长；80 µg/ml 仍可生长；100 µg/ml 显著抑制生长
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.713 'Effect of Cerulenin on NNM-Production and Mycelial Growth' 段
verified_claims.evidence: 'addition of 40 µg of cerulenin per ml ... completely inhibited NNM-production without inhibiting mycelial growth ... Even at 80 µg of cerulenin per ml normal growth occurred; by contrast 100 µg of cerulenin per ml affected growth considerably (data not shown)'

verified_claims.claim: TLC Rf 值 A=0.45, B=0.22, C=0.51, D=0.71, E=0.40；定量波长 A/C/D=274 nm, B/E=232 nm；溶剂体系 CHCl₃-MeOH=5:1
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.712 Extraction and Analysis of NNMs 段
verified_claims.evidence: 'The Rf values of NNM-A, B, C, D and E were 0.45, 0.22, 0.51, 0.71 and 0.40, respectively ... at 274 nm for NNM-A, C and D, and at 232 nm for NNM-B and E ... using chloroform-methanol (5:1) as solvent'

verified_claims.claim: NNM-D 在 cerulenin 体系中 12 h 内被快速消耗；NNM-B 在 12 h 后才开始形成、18 h 达峰、随后缓慢下降
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.714 Bioconversion of NNMs 段
verified_claims.evidence: 'NNM-D was utilized rapidly disappearing within 12 hours ... NNM-B formation began after 12 hours, reached a maximum at 18 hour, and then slowly disappeared from the medium'

verified_claims.claim: NNM 碳骨架由 8 个乙酸单元衍生 (¹³C-NMR 证据，作者 Tanaka et al., 1975)
verified_claims.evidence: 'the carbon skeleton of NNM was derived from eight acetate units'

verified_claims.claim: 作者最终提出的生物合成顺序为 NNM-D → NNM-A → NNM-E → NNM-B；其中 NNM-B→NNM-A 为非酶促化学脱水，NNM-A→NNM-E 为酶促步骤；NNM-D→NNM-A 由粗酶实验证实
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.714–715 Results and Discussion 末段
verified_claims.evidence: 'it was concluded that (1) the NNM-B which accumulated was converted to NNM-A by a non-enzymatic reaction, (2) NNM-A was converted to NNM-E by an enzymatic reaction ... it is proposed that the biosynthesis of the NNMs occurs in the following sequence: NNM-D→NNM-A→NNM-E→NNM-B'
